Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document out lines vibration transducer ( TR 76 ) maintenance procedure I1, to be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
This System consists 
 of 
GT 8030 A,B,C,D,W,8030 B and + 24303 +24304+
24305 + 24306 + 24307 + 24308 / uv 5627 b.
The first draft initiated
by eng. 
 Mohmed Aly Aly Hassan Al Shahat Ahmed Mousa at 
01
March 2003, revised by quality control eng. 
Abdel Monem Al Emam
 at EDEPCo., 
accepted by general
director eng. 
Hamdy 
Abdel Moola Melegy and approved by eng. 
Yousry Mohamed Aly Salama Head Sector of Al Shabab GT PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Tools and Equipment
Complete 
maintenance tools set
Air blower
Multimeter, connection wire (test leads)
Contact cleaner spray
Complete 
maintenance tools set
Air blower
Multimeter, connection wire (test leads)
Contact cleaner spray
Work to be Carried Out
Turn switch to 180 at vibration simulation in the 12 O'clock position, 
and potentiometer scale sitting (24301 
 R2 )_74 %
Check the value of measuring voltage: N12 = 4.37
V. AC at the main unit.
Adjust the measuring and calibration test re MRDS
Magnetic Pick up Vibration Sensor
Clean the 
sensor using Air blower / Contact cleaner spray
Check 
DC R. approximately R=560 ohm
Check the 
ground. between the card terminal and the ground
Disconnect the cable to give you alarm and if OK return the cable to its normal 
position.
Short circuit 
the cables to give you alarm and if OK 
remove the short circuit.
